A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
challenge behaviors are those behaviors that students use to question or disagree with a teacher.

procedural challenge behavior involves questioning the teacher about the process of learning, evaluation challenge behavior is questioning the teacher about evaluation procedures, power play is challenging the teacher's authority, and practicality challenge behavior is questioning whether what is being taught is relevant.
challenge behaviors are a form of communication in which students are seeking to clarify or understand the process and/or content of the class.
